en.card.desc: Normalizes log backends such as Elasticsearch / OpenSearch into one query surface: source list, direct query, volume over time and grouping by field.
en.card.name: Log query
en.error.badLimit: The limit must be a positive integer
en.error.badUrl: The URL must be an absolute http:// or https:// address
en.error.badWindow: The custom time window is incomplete (bar zoom carries that range; click a bar again, or go back to a preset)
en.error.containers: Could not load the container list: {message}
en.error.fieldValues: Could not read this field’s values: {message}
en.error.fieldValuesWindow: No time window yet — run a query first, then expand the field’s values
en.error.fields: Could not load the field list: {message}
en.error.histogram: Could not load the volume chart: {message}
en.error.needFilterField: This filter has no field name
en.error.needFilterValue: This filter has no value (the empty-value bucket cannot be filtered: a filter can only say “field = some value”)
en.error.needGroupBy: Fill in a field to group by first (click “List fields” if you do not know them)
en.field.label: Name
en.hint.addFilter: Add a filter: pick a field on the left, type a value on the right, press Enter
en.hint.aggregationUnsupported: This source cannot aggregate (Loki metric queries are not wired yet), so there is no volume chart or group ranking here.
en.hint.columnLimit: At most {count} extra columns: more would squeeze the message out of sight
en.hint.columnNoValue: This row has no value for {field}
en.hint.containersEmpty: This Docker target has no running containers (this list only shows running ones).
en.hint.density: Compact: each message shows 3 lines (click a row for the full text); Full: the whole message is expanded. The choice is remembered in this browser.
en.hint.docker: Container logs come from the Docker panel plugin own /api/dsh-docker/logs: no until, a capped tail, and no grep — ask the agent for docker_logs_grep when you need real search.
en.hint.dockerMissing: This path needs the Docker container panel plugin (not detected): install and enable it to read container logs here.
en.hint.dockerStale: These logs are from the previous fetch, not the current “{container}” — click “View logs” again after changing the conditions.
en.hint.dockerTargetUnknown: (not a target in the Docker panel)
en.hint.expandRow: Expand this row (all labels and the raw text)
en.hint.fieldCount: {count} rows on this page carry this field
en.hint.fieldGroupToggle: Expand or collapse the “{name}” group ({count} fields)
en.hint.fieldValuesOwnFilter: The numbers here come from a subset that ignores this field’s own filter — that is how the other values show up.
en.hint.fieldsColumn: A column needs per-row values; the number is this page’s row count.
en.hint.fieldsColumnFull: Columns can only come from fields that appear on this page: a column shows each row’s label value, and other fields have no value on this page’s rows — the column would be all —.
en.hint.fieldsToggle: Show or hide the field panel (columns and filters; it floats over the results and never narrows the log)
en.hint.fieldsTooMany: Showing the first {shown} (of {count}): narrow it down with the filter above
en.hint.filterValueFirst: Pick a field on the left first — this box lists that field’s values
en.hint.filters: Filters go out as “field = value” (the host’s structured filters): the rows, the volume chart and the ranking all narrow with them. One filter per field. Loki does not support structured filters — put the condition into the query string there.
en.hint.groupBlankNoDrill: The empty-value row cannot be drilled into: a filter can only say “field = some value”, not “the field is missing”.
en.hint.groups: This ranking comes from the backend terms aggregation (not from counting this page — the page is capped by the limit, so counting it would only give you a fake ranking). Click a row to drill into it (adds one filter and re-runs the query); click it again to undo.
en.hint.groupsTruncated: There are more buckets than this ranking; only the first part is drawn.
en.hint.histogram: This chart comes from the backend time-bucketing (not from counting this page — the page is capped by the limit, so counting it would only give you a fake distribution).
en.hint.histogramClipped: The buckets are close together (the max is less than 3× the min), so the bars start near the bottom to make the differences visible — bar height shows relative height only, not a count-proportional scale. Hover a bar for its exact count.
en.hint.histogramTruncated: The window is longer than this chart; only the first part is drawn.
en.hint.index: Index expression for ES / OpenSearch: empty means the path in the URL, and if that is empty too it becomes *,-.* (all indices except dot-prefixed system indices).
en.hint.levelPaged: Levels filter as “and up” (warn+ in the dropdown means warn and up), and only on the returned page (the host’s own semantics): the counts and truncation signals still describe the unfiltered page. Per-level totals need a real level field in the backend — when the index has none (ES often infers the level from the message), the group ranking is empty too.
en.hint.noRaw: This source has no raw text
en.hint.notImplemented: You can query the selected source right below; once results exist, the left column is the field list (on this page / other available / type conflicts — click a name to filter), and the “Group by field” box opens the same candidates. New columns and row details are described above; per-line context still lives in the agent tool loglens_context.
en.hint.query: Queries the selected source through the same execution layer the agent tools use (identical normalization and truncation signals).
en.hint.rawTruncated: The raw text is too long; showing the first {shown} characters (of {total})
en.hint.refreshContainers: Re-fetches the container list (it changes as containers start and stop; this does not refresh the logs below)
en.hint.rowLabelFilter: Add a filter {field} = {value} (remove it via the ranking row or the × on the chip)
en.hint.rowLabelPanel: Show all {count} labels (click one to filter by “field = value”)
en.hint.rowSensitive: Row details can contain sensitive fields (raw and labels come verbatim from the log backend)
en.hint.sort: Sort this page: {order}. Click again for the next mode (time / level / message). Only the rows already returned are reordered — the backend has no server-side sort, so paging still follows its own order.
en.hint.sourcesCollapse: Collapse the source settings (leaves one summary line so the query and results get the screen)
en.hint.sourcesExpand: Expand the source settings (add, change or remove log sources)
en.hint.staleResults: The query conditions changed — the results below are still from the previous run. Run the query again first; until then “Group” and “Next page” stay off (the paging cursor belongs to the previous query).
en.hint.valueActive: {value} is being filtered on (click again to undo)
en.hint.zoomBar: Click to zoom into this slice (narrows the time window to this bar)
en.hint.zoomBarCancel: Click again to undo the zoom (back to the preset you zoomed from)
en.hint.zoomClamped: Zoomed to the 1-minute minimum (that bucket is narrower than this; anything narrower finds nothing).
en.list.empty: No log source yet — click “+ Add source”.
en.list.noBuckets: No data to group by in this window
en.list.noHit: No hits (widen the window or loosen the query)
en.list.noLogs: No logs (try a wider time window or a larger tail)
en.meta.maybeMore: Showing the first {count} rows — there may be more; raise the row limit to see further
en.msg.fieldValuesEmpty: This field has no value on this page (the rows here may not carry it)
en.msg.fieldsEmpty: This source returned no field names (you can type one, e.g. container.name)
en.msg.memoryOnly: The host has no settings service; changes last only in this process
en.msg.noColumnableFields: No columnable field on this page (nothing matched, or this page’s rows carry no labels)
en.panel.title: Log sources
en.placeholder.label: e.g. local Loki
en.placeholder.queryLogql: Query string (LogQL, e.g. {job="app"} |= "error"; empty means everything)
en.placeholder.queryLucene: Query string (Lucene: AND / OR / NOT must be uppercase, space means OR, quotes mean phrase; empty = everything)

zh.card.desc: 把 Elasticsearch / OpenSearch 等日志后端归一化成一个查询面：来源清单、直连查询、时间分布与按字段分组。
zh.card.name: 日志查询
zh.error.badKind: 类型不认识（支持 Loki / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Docker）
zh.error.badUrl: 地址必须是 http:// 或 https:// 开头的绝对地址
zh.error.badWindow: 自定义时间窗不完整（点柱放大时会带上这一段；重新点一根柱，或改回预设档）
zh.error.fieldValuesWindow: 还没有可用的时间窗：先查一次，再展开字段的值
zh.error.needFilterValue: 这条筛选没有值（空值那一桶筛不了：筛选只能表达「字段 = 某值」）
zh.error.needGroupBy: 先填要分组的字段（不知道有哪些字段就点「有哪些字段」）
zh.field.label: 名称
zh.hint.addFilter: 加一条筛选：左边选字段、右边填值，回车生效
zh.hint.aggregationUnsupported: 当前来源不支持聚合（Loki 的指标查询还没接），所以这里没有时间分布与分组榜。
zh.hint.columnLimit: 最多同时加 {count} 列：再加正文会被挤到看不清
zh.hint.containersEmpty: 这个 Docker 目标上没有运行中的容器（这里只列运行中的）。
zh.hint.containersMatched: 命中 {count} 个 / 共 {total} 个
zh.hint.density: 紧凑：每条日志只显示 3 行（点行看全文）；完整：正文全展开。选择会记在本机浏览器里。
zh.hint.docker: 容器日志走的是 Docker 面板插件自己的 /api/dsh-docker/logs：这条路没有 until、行数有上限、没有 grep——要精确检索请让 agent 用 docker_logs_grep。
zh.hint.dockerMissing: 这条路径要「Docker 容器面板」插件（当前没检测到它）：装上并启用后，这里可以直接看容器日志。
zh.hint.dockerStale: 下面这份日志是上一次拉取的，不是「{container}」现在的：改完条件要点「看日志」才会重新拉。
zh.hint.dockerTargetUnknown: （不在 Docker 面板的目标里）
zh.hint.expandRow: 展开这一行（全部标签与原文）
zh.hint.fieldCount: 这一页有 {count} 行带这个字段
zh.hint.fieldGroupToggle: 展开 / 收起「{name}」这一组（{count} 个字段）
zh.hint.fieldValuesOwnFilter: 这一格的数是「不受本字段约束」的子集：想切换这个字段的值，这里才列得出别的值。
zh.hint.fieldsColumn: 列要有逐行值才能加；数字是本页行数。
zh.hint.fieldsColumnFull: 列只能从「本页命中」的字段加：列的值取自这一页每一行的标签，其余字段在这一页的行里没有值，加出来会全是 —。
zh.hint.fieldsToggle: 打开 / 收起字段浮层（列与筛选的入口；浮在结果上，不占日志宽度）
zh.hint.fieldsTooMany: 只列了前 {shown} 个（共 {count} 个）：用上面的过滤收窄
zh.hint.filterValueFirst: 先在左边选一个字段：值那一格要列的是「这个字段的值」
zh.hint.filters: 筛选按「字段 = 值」下发（走宿主的结构化 filters）：行、时间分布与分组榜都跟着收窄。一个字段只有一条。Loki 不支持结构化筛选——用它时把条件写进查询串。
zh.hint.groupBlankNoDrill: 空值那一条不能下钻：筛选只能表达「字段 = 某值」，表达不了「字段缺失」。
zh.hint.groupDrillRow: 按 {field} = {value} 下钻（再点一次取消）
zh.hint.groups: 这张榜来自后端的 terms 聚合（不是数这一页——这一页被条数截断过，数它只会得到一个假的排名）。点一条即按它下钻（加一条筛选重查一次），再点一次取消。
zh.hint.groupsTruncated: 桶比这张榜长，只画了前一部分。
zh.hint.histogram: 这张图来自后端按时间分桶（不是数这一页——这一页被条数截断过，数它只会得到一个假的分布）。
zh.hint.histogramClipped: 各段条数挨得近（最大值不到最小值的 3 倍），柱子从接近底部起画，好让差异看得出来——柱高只表示相对高低，不是与条数成正比。悬停任一根看它的实际条数。
zh.hint.histogramTruncated: 窗口比这张图长，只画了前一部分。
zh.hint.index: ES / OpenSearch 的索引表达式：留空时用地址里的路径，地址里也没有就是 *,-.*（全部索引但排除点号系统索引）。
zh.hint.levelPaged: 级别按「及以上」筛（下拉里的 warn+ 就是 warn 及以上），且是在「返回的这一页」上筛的（宿主口径）：计数与截断提示仍是未筛的整页。要按级别看全量只能靠后端真有级别字段——索引里没有时（ES 常从正文推断），分组榜也会是空的。
zh.hint.notImplemented: 下面可以直接查当前来源；结果出来后左边是字段栏（本页命中 / 其余可用 / 类型冲突，点名字就筛选），「分组字段」那一格点开也是当前来源的字段名候选。新增列与行详情的口径见上；「某一行前后」的上下文仍在 agent 侧的 loglens_context 里。
zh.hint.query: 面板直查当前来源：走的是与 agent 工具同一套执行层（同一份归一化与截断信号）。
zh.hint.rawTruncated: 原文太长，只显示前 {shown} 个字符（共 {total} 个）
zh.hint.refreshContainers: 重新拉一次容器清单（容器起停之后它才会变；这里刷新的不是下面那份日志）
zh.hint.rowLabelFilter: 按 {field} = {value} 加一条筛选（再点榜上那条或芯片上的 × 可去掉）
zh.hint.rowLabelPanel: 查看全部 {count} 个标签（点一个就按「字段 = 值」筛）
zh.hint.rowSensitive: 行详情里可能有敏感字段（原文与标签原样来自日志后端）
zh.hint.sort: 本页排序：{order}。再点一次换下一档（时间 / 级别 / 正文循环）。只重排**已返回的这一页**——后端没有服务端排序，翻页取到的仍是后端顺序。
zh.hint.sourcesCollapse: 收起来源配置（只留下一行摘要，查询与结果能多占一屏）
zh.hint.sourcesExpand: 展开来源配置（新增 / 修改 / 删除日志来源）
zh.hint.staleResults: 查询条件已经改过——下面这份结果还是上一次查询的。先点「查询」按新条件刷新；在那之前「分组」与「下一页」都收着（翻页的游标属于上一次查询）。
zh.hint.zoomBar: 点一下放大到这一段（把时间窗夹到这一根柱）
zh.hint.zoomBarCancel: 再点一次取消放大（回到放大之前那一档）
zh.hint.zoomClamped: 已放大到最短 1 分钟（那一档分桶比这还窄，再窄就查不出东西了）。
zh.list.empty: 还没有日志来源，点「+ 新增来源」加一个。
zh.list.noBuckets: 这个窗口里没有可分组的数据
zh.list.noHit: 没有命中（换个时间窗，或放宽查询串）
zh.list.noLogs: 没有日志（换个大点的时间窗或行数再试）
zh.meta.maybeMore: 已显示前 {count} 行，可能有更多：把条数调大可以看得更全
zh.msg.fieldValuesEmpty: 这个字段在这一页没有值（可能这一页的行都没带它）
zh.msg.fieldsEmpty: 这个来源没有返回字段名（可以直接手填，比如 container.name）
zh.msg.memoryOnly: 宿主没有 settings 服务，改动只在本次进程内有效
zh.msg.noColumnableFields: 这一页没有可加列的字段（本页命中为空，或这一页的行都没带标签）
zh.panel.title: 日志来源
zh.placeholder.label: 例如：本地 Loki
zh.placeholder.queryLucene: 查询串（Lucene：AND / OR / NOT 要大写、空格是「或」、引号是短语；留空即全量）
